subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’,

A − B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A × B means ‘A is the wife of B’ and

A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is M related to Q if ‘M − N + O × P ÷ Q’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/153c6a6e313de03f2911e6352e768c319ce48bd8d9b10cf6c7d58c07f604979a.png]

Given Expression: M – N + O × P ÷ Q

M – N: M is the brother of N.

N + O: N is the mother of O.

O × P: O is the wife of P.

P ÷ Q: P is the father of Q.

According to the given information Family Tree Representation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3c011b029387951b096585d0911e08bfa671ea9a4d6d5dbfff7b59d425a1d83.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/185a4fcaccfa7e42126c62624d49356c3731e97bf0479c5618e937d219accb9a.png] 

Relationship between M and Q: Q's father is P. P's wife is O. O's mother is N. N's brother is M.

Therefore, M is **Mother's mother's brother** of Q.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
